subject: Request for temporary uptime/latency grace during model onramp
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@onramplabs.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@onramplabs.com
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary uptime/latency grace for beta onramp

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the model performance looks promising. As we start routing limited production traffic to the new recommender model (beta), our SRE team has flagged a couple of predictable risk areas where we will likely see tail latency spikes during warm-up and state transfer windows.

We'd like to request a short-term exception to the standard SLA while we complete onramp and warm caches across our traffic slices:

- Duration: 10 days starting Oct 4 (ramp phase)
- Uptime tolerance: allow one scheduled brief interruption per region (up to 30m) without penalty
- Latency band: relax 95th percentile target from 200ms to 350ms for the first 72 hours after each code/model push

We are prepared to accept conservative rate limits and fall back to the smaller embedders if needed. Attached is our onramp plan and a recent latency trace that shows the expected tail behavior.

Can Redwood confirm whether this temporary accommodation is possible and what documentation you need for audit? We are aiming to sign the pilot amendment by Oct 6 so engineering can proceed.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Product Operations
OnRamp Labs

Attachments: onramp_beta_plan.pdf (PDF, 230KB), latency-trace-20281002.log (text, 58KB)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@onramplabs.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uptime/latency grace for beta onramp

Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the plan.

Short answers up front: yes, we can offer a time-boxed exception for a controlled onramp, with conditions. I'd like our infra and product leads to weigh in on specifics so we can scope the exception in a formal amendment.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus (infra) to confirm realistic latency windows and impact to routing policies.
2) Evelyn (account lead) to draft a one-page pilot amendment (SLA carve-out + rollback triggers).
3) Schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize the runbook and acceptance criteria.

Two quick items for the amendment:
- We'll require explicit fallback rules (which model/endpoint to route to on failure).
- We'll attach a short monitoring playbook (pager on-call owners, threshold definitions, and an incident scoreboard).

I've attached a template we use for these temporary exceptions and included the drive link for shared notes.

Can everyone make 09:00 PT tomorrow?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-temporary-exception-template.docx
Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1OnRampPilot

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Elaine Park <elaine@onramplabs.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 13:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary uptime/latency grace for beta onramp

Quick technical note from infra:

We reviewed the onramp_plan.pdf and the latency traces. Observations and proposed limits:

- Warm-up behavior: long-tail spikes occur predominantly on cold KV-cache misses after model swaps; expected P95 can climb ~1.6x for ~10-30 minutes after a roll.
- Recommended SLA carve-out: allow P95 <= 350ms for a 72-hour window post-deploy for traffic slices listed in the plan.
- Scheduled interruption allowance: we can permit one scheduled maintenance window up to 30 minutes per region as long as it's notified 24h in advance and we coordinate fallback routing.
- Rollback triggers: if error rate > 0.8% for more than 15 minutes or P95 > 500ms for more than 30 minutes, we execute an automatic fallback to the stable model.

Operational requests from our side:
- Please provide the exact traffic segment IDs and expected QPS per segment (so we can tune autoscaling).
- If OnRamp wants an SLA credit waiver documented, legal will need a signed pilot amendment. Evelyn — can you draft and circulate?

Link to metric dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/pen/onramp-pilot (viewable to OnRamp via shared token)

I attached the fallback-model-config.yaml we intend to use. Marcus

Attachment: fallback-model-config.yaml (YAML, 4KB)
